title: Organic Soft
description: Earthy sage, warm sun-baked terracotta, tactile clay tones, gentle botanical diffusion, and smooth, flowing fluid deceleration.
do: Curate soothing natural botanic colors with warm parchment contrast

Never rush the visual pacing; let scenes breathe naturally
